description: One dashboard: its whole document (the current version people see, or the version you name), the drafts waiting to be accepted, and its newest versions with who made each and what changed. Read it before change_dashboard.

dashboard_id.description: The dashboard's id (list_dashboards gives them, dsh_...).

version.description: A version to show the document of (a draft's number, say). Left out: the current version.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

title: Read one dashboard
